data_identity.paper_mismatch: Paper describes A549/K562/MCF7; original scPerturb preprocessing explicitly sets sciPlex2 cell_line=A549.

verified_current_api.version: PyTDC 1.1.15 (not established as version used for published Table 6)
verified_current_api.drug_preprocessing: No normalization, log1p, or HVG selection in PerturbOutcome drug branch; 5000-HVG code is genetic-perturbation branch only. Upstream h5ad state still needs inspection.
verified_current_api.split: Default 80/10/10, random_state=42. Cold split groups drug identity within cell_line; doses are not split separately. Returns AnnData.obs subsets, not expression.
verified_current_api.controls: All control cells separated before splitting; high-level returns train/dev only but control exists in self.split.
verified_current_api.predict_format_as_coded: dict[cell_line] -> pandas.DataFrame. Numeric columns are averaged across rows; row pairing is not used. Gene names/order are not checked beyond numeric-vector length. Intended biological output should be cells x genes in exact frozen gene order.
verified_current_api.score_as_coded: For each cell line, mean all numeric columns over cells, then sklearn.metrics.r2_score(y_true_mean,y_pred_mean); arithmetic average across cell lines. Does not subtract control. Does not group drug/dose unless caller scopes each test separately.
verified_current_api.multi_run: evaluate_many requires len(preds)>=5, returns mean_R^2 and std_R^2 with numpy.std(ddof=0).
breakages: 4-drug default unseen split raises ValueError when splitting 1 heldout drug between validation and test.
Default seen remove_unseen=True removes drugs present in training and empties synthetic validation/test.
Data splits contain metadata only, not expression.
Ignored DataFrame.drop result retains numeric metadata and contaminates score.
No high-level seed parameter; default dataset is Aissa, not sciPlex2.

requirements: Use TDC specified test set unchanged.
Train with train/validation only; train/validation split may be customized.
At least five independent model runs; report mean and standard deviation.
Submit scores plus model summary incl parameter count and hardware.
